title: Anti Rodent Test as as per TEC/GR/FA/DWC-034/02/AUG-19 - Electrical Safety Testing Laboratory
description: Anti Rodent Test as as per TEC/GR/FA/DWC-034/02/AUG-19 is a test used to determine whether or not a product is effective at repelling rodents.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Look no further than the Anti Rodent Test as per TEC/GR/FA/DWC-034/02/AUG-19.

This innovative solution is designed to put an end to unwanted rodent activity and provide peace of mind for homeowners and business owners alike. In this blog post, we’ll dive into the details of this test and how it can benefit you in the long run.

sections.heading: What is the Anti Rodent Test?
paragraphs: The Anti Rodent Test is a test used to determine whether or not a product is effective at repelling rodents.
This test is conducted by exposing the product to a group of rats or mice for a period of time, typically 24 hours. The number of rodents that are repelled by the product is then recorded.

sections.heading: Why is the Test important?
paragraphs: The Anti Rodent Test is important because it is a requirement for all new products being introduced into the market. This test ensures that the product does not cause any adverse effects on rodents.

sections.heading: How to conduct the Anti Rodent Test?
paragraphs: The anti rodent test is a performance qualification test to assess the efficacy of an insecticide against rodents. It is conducted as per TEC/GR/FA/DWC-//AUG-. The procedure for conducting the test is as follows: 1. The test area shall be prepared by cleaning and removing all food sources. 2. A standard bait block shall be placed in the centre of the test area. 3. Five rats or mice shall be released into the test area and allowed to feed on the bait for a period of 24 hours. 4. After 24 hours, the number of dead rodents shall be counted and recorded.their carcasses examined for evidence of insecticide poisoning. 5. The results of the test shall be recorded and reported accordingly.

sections.heading: What are the benefits of the Anti Rodent Test?
paragraphs: There are many benefits to using the Anti Rodent Test as a means of pest control in your home or office. Perhaps the most obvious benefit is that it will help to keep rodents away from your property.

This is important because rodents can carry diseases that can be harmful to humans, such as the Hantavirus. In addition, rodents can also cause damage to your property by gnawing on wires and other materials.

By using the Anti Rodent Test, you can help to protect your property from these potential risks. Another benefit of Anti Rodent Test as as per TEC/GR/FA/DWC-034/02/AUG-19 is that it is an environmentally friendly option for pest control. Unlike many traditional methods of pest control, such as pesticides, the Anti Rodent Test does not use any harmful chemicals. This means that it is safe for you and your family, as well as the environment. Finally, the Anti Rodent Test is an affordable option for pest control. Many people believe that hiring a professional exterminator is the only way to get rid of pests, but this is simply not true.
The Anti Rodent Test is a cost-effective way to get rid of pests without breaking the bank.

sections.heading: Conclusion
paragraphs: In conclusion, it is clear that using Anti Rodent tests as per TEC/GR/FA/DWC-034/02/AUG-19 is a great way of ensuring that your environment and structures remain free from rodents.
This type of test will help keep your buildings safe by eliminating the need for frequent follow up visits to deal with the potential health risks associated with rodent infestation.

Furthermore, it also provides an economical solution as compared to other methods used in controlling pests and rodents. Therefore, if you want to ensure complete safety and well-being in your home or business premises, then this anti-rodent test should be considered mandatory.
